props.body: Get the cover you need to protect your business. Fast, flexible, and backed by Hiscox expertise.

props.title: Trusted partner

props.title: Professional Indemnity

props.heading: Not sure what cover you need?
props.body: Our team can help you find the right insurance for your business. Get a tailored quote in minutes.

props.question: How much does business insurance cost?
props.answer: The cost depends on the type of cover, your industry, and the size of your business. Most Hiscox policies start from a few hundred pounds a year. Use our quote tool to get an accurate price for your specific needs.

props.question: What does professional indemnity insurance cover?
props.answer: Professional indemnity insurance covers legal costs and compensation if a client claims your professional advice, design, or service caused them a financial loss — even if you didn't make a mistake.

props.question: Can I adjust my cover after purchasing?
props.answer: Yes. You can update your policy at any time through your Hiscox account. Upgrades take effect immediately; refunds for downgraded cover are calculated pro-rata.
